# Lodestone

> The public slice of Michaelangelo Caporale's knowledge vault — systems thinking, AI alignment, and craft.

Notes are the author's own writing, verbatim except privacy redactions. Fetch only the notes relevant to your question rather than loading everything.

## Notes

- [1 - Organic Alignment Thesis](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/1-organic-alignment-thesis): The organic-alignment thesis — alignment grown not imposed, the "we becomes I" emergence, alignment as an ongoing process, and the main critiques
- [2 - The Biological Theory - Transitions & Levin](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/2-the-biological-theory-transitions-levin): The biological theory of alignment — the major evolutionary transitions, the coordination mechanisms bodies use, and Levin's cognitive light cone with the goal stored in the coupling
- [3 - Coordination Mechanics - Arbitration, Variety & the Channel](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/3-coordination-mechanics-arbitration-variety-the-channel): The mechanics of coordination — distributed computation through an honest shared signal, arbitration/tie-breaking as the center's only irreducible job, requisite variety and optimal concentration, and the trust/channel properties that make coupling work
- [6 - The Coupling Spine - From the Formal Model to the Authored Top](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/6-the-coupling-spine-from-the-formal-model-to-the-authored-top): The coupling spine — the self-scaling-players formal model, coupling as a shared consequence-carrying variable, its nesting up the levels, the empty goal at the top, and the sharpened thesis that alignment is a bound, faithful signal at every level anchored in an authored top
- [7 - Measuring Emergence - Causal Emergence & the Free Energy Principle](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/7-measuring-emergence-causal-emergence-the-free-energy-principle): The instruments behind the coupling spine — causal emergence (Hoel) as the "when" a higher self forms, the Free Energy Principle as the "what it does and why it lasts," and a candidate definition of alignment as the cross-level coupling between a part's free-energy gradient and the whole's
- [Attractor Dynamics in Education Systems](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/attractor-dynamics-in-education-systems): Explains how education systems exhibit homogeneity due to attractor dynamics and self-reinforcing feedbacks, hindering reform
- [Backend Services for AI Coding Agents](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/backend-services-for-ai-coding-agents): Comparison of BaaS platforms, RAG databases, deployment services, and automation backends optimized for use with Claude Code
- [Best Practices for Coaching](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/best-practices-for-coaching): Best practices of effective personal coaching — powerful questions, advice vs. asking, challenging perspectives, and frameworks (GROW, CBT, MI, positive psychology) — framed as guidance for building an AI coach
- [ChatGPT - Societal Misalignment - Feb 12 2026](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/chatgpt-societal-misalignment-feb-12-2026): Explores how societal misalignment stems from optimizing proxies over human flourishing, amplified by AI
- [Claude - Hunter-Gatherers and Affluence - Feb 18 2026](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/claude-hunter-gatherers-and-affluence-feb-18-2026): Examines hunter-gatherer affluence, contrasting it with modern consumerism driven by Neolithic shifts and social comparison
- [Claude Prompts](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/claude-prompts): Strategies for prompting Claude, using software engineering analogies and progressive disclosure for clearer AI explanations
- [Cognitive Load Theory](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/cognitive-load-theory): Notes on Cognitive Load Theory — working-memory limits and the three types of load (intrinsic, extraneous, germane)
- [Complexity Science — Study Threads](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/complexity-science-study-threads): Running list of complexity-science study threads — edge of chaos, self-expanding technology, and the dynamics of functional beliefs
- [Connection & Communication](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/connection-communication): Principles for genuine connection and communication, emphasizing understanding others' core values
- [Definition of Information](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/definition-of-information): A fundamental definition of information as systemic constraints, distinct from meaning or observation
- [Effective Project Planning - Research Synthesis](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/effective-project-planning-research-synthesis): Comprehensive synthesis of project planning principles across classical frameworks, evidence-based research, failure modes, personal planning, and modern methodologies, distilled into universal principles
- [Framework - Energy Sinks](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/framework-energy-sinks): Details a framework for escaping energy sinks in social systems, focusing on education's proxy-metric traps
- [Good Personal Questions](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/good-personal-questions): Collected questions that open up meaningful conversation — icebreakers, prompts, and inquiries worth using when meeting or reconnecting with people
- [Great Product Development](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/great-product-development): Outlines a structured product development process (Discover, Frame, Build, Learn) for de-risking products through continuous user feedback and iteration
- [How This Wiki Was Built](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/how-this-wiki-was-built): How this public wiki is generated from a private Obsidian vault — the opt-in privacy model, the LLM curator, the leak linter, and the two-layer Karpathy-style build
- [How self-organizing systems update their models of reality](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/how-self-organizing-systems-update-their-models-of-reality): Examines the universal computational signature governing model updating in self-organizing systems
- [Knowledge Management System](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/knowledge-management-system): Outlines components, tools, and workflows for a personal knowledge management system, focusing on Obsidian, AI integration, and information processing
- [Mitra Martin - Building Intergenerational Containers](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/mitra-martin-building-intergenerational-containers): Synthesis of Mitra Martin's Substack (Center for Numinous World-Building) on building intergenerational containers, organized into five clusters, plus size logic and a practical first step
- [Multi-Scale Coordination — Arbitration, Alignment, and the Boundary of the Self](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/multi-scale-coordination-arbitration-alignment-and-the-boundary-of-the-self): A single model of coordination across scales — a thin center that arbitrates, a distributed layer that acts, held together by a shared signal — and why human institutions strain against it where bodies don't
- [Presentation Outline](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/presentation-outline): Slide-by-slide talking points for the "Framings on Alignment" talk, reframing AI alignment as a coupling problem for collective flourishing
- [QUESTIONS](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/questions): A curated list of deep questions regarding AI, technology's role, and designing better societal systems
- [Society and Systems MOC](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/society-and-systems-moc): Map connecting notes on how society optimizes for proxies over true values, and paths toward realignment
- [Society in the Age of AI Abundance](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/society-in-the-age-of-ai-abundance): A sketch of society under AI abundance — contribution-based ~20-hour weeks, vocations preserved, growth through contribution, wealth distribution rethought — plus the wage critique and AI-pause idea that came with it
- [Tim Ferriss — Daily Prioritization Process](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/tim-ferriss-daily-prioritization-process): Tim Ferriss's morning process for picking the one task worth doing — surface what's causing anxiety, filter with two leverage questions, then protect one uninterrupted block for it
- [Turning AI Into a World-Class Designer (Anshu Chimala)](https://mvacaporale.github.io/lodestone-wiki/notes/turning-ai-into-a-world-class-designer-anshu-chimala): Lessons on getting distinctive, non-generic design out of AI by treating it as a guided process (Double Diamond) rather than a one-shot prompt
